classification.difficultyReason: Evaluate a large numerical expression, interpret one minute per outcome and convert the resulting duration into days and hours.

content.prompt: In a lottery there are $\dfrac{45\times44\times43\times42\times41\times40}{720}$ different possible outcomes. If I mark each outcome on an entry form one at a time, and it takes me an average of 1 minute to mark each outcome, how long will it take me to cover all different possible outcomes?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}N&=\frac{45\times44\times43\times42\times41\times40}{720}\\N&=8\,145\,060\end{align*}$$
At 1 minute per outcome, the total time is $8\,145\,060$ minutes. Using $60$ minutes per hour and $24$ hours per day:
$$\begin{align*}t&=\frac{8\,145\,060}{60}\text{ hours}\\t&=135\,751\text{ hours}\\t&=(5656\times24+7)\text{ hours}\\t&=5656\text{ days and }7\text{ hours}.\end{align*}$$
